person.name: Alex
person.photo_ignore: its background, its lighting and its clothing
person.wears: a dark olive waxed jacket with the hood up, dark jeans and worn boots, a small bag clamped to his chest

goal: An empty city street at night under sodium streetlights. Alex runs down the pavement and calls back to someone he is leading to safety, out of breath but sure of the way.
place: Mustard-amber sodium lamps, each a soft pool with a hazy halo and a faint cyan-green fringe, wet black asphalt with long lamp reflections, shuttered shopfronts, a thin mist catching the light, olive shadows. Soft and analog, light diffusion, fine film grain.
performance: Someone behind him is slower and frightened, and because he cannot let them see his own fear, it comes out as encouragement. He runs hard with the bag clamped to his chest and the hood up, breath ragged, and twists his shoulders back toward them as he calls out between gulps of air, his voice cracking on the last word. Then he turns forward again and drives on, a short breath of relief leaving him as the way opens up. {LINE}
sound: The sound is only his breathless voice, his boots on wet pavement, a bag strap creaking, a faint buzz from the streetlights and a distant siren.
subject_position: running away from the lens down the middle of the street, centre-left of the frame
camera: Shot 1, the only shot: the camera is hand-held with a 28 mm lens feel and a strong shake, following Alex from behind at about three metres while he jogs at about 2.4 metres a second down the middle of the street. It frames him from behind in a medium wide shot, head to mid-thigh, centre-left, with the wet street and the lamps ahead of him bouncing and swaying with every stride. Alex is only partly in the frame at the very start and settles into it within about two seconds, and the shake never lets him sit still in the frame.

line.text: Keep going, it's just around the next corner.
